Docker workers quick setup: Quick start: the app, Docker API proxy, and database must be reachable on the same Docker network. The project includes a ready-to-use compose.yaml.
Docker workers compose command: From the project directory, run: docker compose up --build -d. Then refresh this page. The status should show that Docker is connected.
Docker workers manual setup: When running the app separately, set M3_DOCKER_API_URL to a reachable Docker API proxy and M3_WORKER_NETWORK to the Docker network name. Build and make the M3_WORKER_IMAGE image available to Docker. Worker containers must also reach the same database and RabbitMQ using addresses valid inside that network. Do not expose the Docker socket/API directly to the network.
